The Navy released this artist’s rendering of the Boeing F/A-XX, highlighting the Navy’s 6th-generation fighter intended to replace the service’s fleet of F/A-18 Super Hornets. Artist rendering: NAVAIR Public Release SPR-2026-0601. Distribution Statement A – “Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.”
Under the contract, Boeing will design, build and deliver the Navy's 6th-generation fighter
ST. LOUIS , Sept. 29, 2026 / PRNewswire / -- The U.S. Navy announced Boeing (NYSE: BA) has been awarded a multi-billion-dollar contract to produce its F/A-XX aircraft. The fighter will revolutionize advancements in open mission systems architecture, advanced mission systems and operational reach and capacity. F/A-XX is intended to replace the service's fleet of F/A-18 Super Hornets.
"It's an honor to be selected to produce the Navy's first sixth - generation platform. Backed by decades of work, bolstered by game-changing innovations and solidified by the investments we've made in new facilities uniquely suited to build multiple products with next generation capabilities, our dedicated and talented team is ready to execute this critical program," said Steve Parker, president and chief executive officer, Boeing Defense, Space & Security.
The contract is Boeing's second selection for 6th-generation fighter work following the award of the U.S. Air Force's F-47 program in 2025.
"Delivering two advanced fighters in parallel was always our plan, and we invested accordingly. We are ready and able to build multiple concurrent future combat aircraft franchise programs," said Parker.
Construction continues on Boeing's secure manufacturing facility, the largest in the U.S. Located in St. Louis, the facility will be part of the world's most advanced, all-digital aerospace design and manufacturing system.
"Investment in facilities is just one part of the story; we're also investing in technology and people so that we can deliver for our customers," Parker added.
The technical and programmatic details of F/A-XX remain classified under U.S. national security and export laws.
A leading global aerospace company and top U.S. exporter, Boeing develops, manufactures and services commercial airplanes, defense products and space systems for customers in more than 150 countries. Our U.S. and global workforce and supplier base drive innovation, economic opportunity, sustainability and community impact. Boeing is committed to fostering a culture based on our core values of safety, quality and integrity.

title: Data Center Resource 360 de Veolia : Comment passer de la crise de l'acceptabilité à la collaboration territoriale
source: Veolia - Financial Press Releases / Financial Press Releases RSS
content_text:
Veolia's Data Center Resource 360: Moving from an Acceptability Crisis to Territorial Collaboration
Blog listing 
28 Sep. 2026 
Reading time: 7 min
Offre
Industrial
City/Community
 
ANN FENG 
Director of Innovation & Development for the Microelectronics Market, Veolia
Data centers have become strategic infrastructure, but their resource consumption is raising new challenges around local acceptability.
In 2024, they consumed approximately 415 TWh of electricity worldwide , representing nearly 1.5% of global demand. According to the IEA , this consumption could more than double by 2030, reaching 945 TWh , driven by digital technology and the rise of artificial intelligence.
For operators and local authorities alike, the challenge now is to balance performance, resource efficiency, and local benefits. Territorial integration has become the essential condition for data centers' long-term sustainability.
Waste heat recovery, cooling water reuse, waste management: the circular economy is transforming data centers into drivers of local resilience.
With our integrated Data Center Resource 360 offering , I invite you to discover how Veolia supports this transition toward sustainable data centers that are truly integrated into their local communities.
 
 
Data Center Resource 360: An Offering for Sustainable Data Centers 
Building on our proven successes around the world, we have brought together all of our expertise into a single solution: the comprehensive Data Center Resource 360 offering. 
This offer helps accelerate the licensing process, reduce project timelines, and ensure uncompromising performance. The benefits are tangible: resource security, cost reduction, societal acceptability, and competitive advantage. 
Designed to address the challenges faced by industrial operators and municipalities alike, it is built on four pillars: reliability, a negative carbon footprint, waste circularity, and a positive water footprint. Through integrated energy, water, and waste management, we offer: 
Energy 
Up to 20% energy reuse efficiency through waste heat recovery, supplying district heating networks and industrial facilities. 
Water 
Up to 75% reduction in water footprint through water reuse, enabled by autonomous, containerized systems. 
Waste 
Up to 95% of waste recycled and reused through a circular waste management approach. 
Reliability 
Real-time optimization through Hubgrade, combining AI and predictive analytics, enhanced by Amazon Web Services’ AI capabilities. 
"This innovative offering is designed to support the growth of the strategic digital infrastructure shaping today's world. We are proud to be the first and only company to offer a truly global, integrated, and circular solution for data centers."
Estelle Brachlianoff, CEO of Veolia.
Download the brocure 
Who is the Data Center Resource 360 Offering For? 
Data center operators 
Municipalities and local authorities 
Colocation clients 2 
Edge infrastructure clients 3 
Technology companies seeking sustainability 
Circular economy and ecological transition stakeholders 
Contact an expert 
Veolia, the International Data Center Expert: Success Stories 
District Heating in Braunschweig, Germany
Veolia designed, implemented, and now operates an innovative system for recovering waste heat from a large data center. This thermal energy, once lost to the atmosphere, is now fed directly into a 365-kilometer district heating network managed by Veolia. Thanks to this circular initiative, more than 56,000 residents benefit from l ow-carbon heating , harnessing a total capacity of 800 MW.
Water Optimization in Illinois, United States
Our teams optimized the cooling system chemistry for a major operator. By increasing concentration cycles through a patented automatic control system, Veolia reduced water consumption by 50% while generating $150,000 in annual cost savings for the site.
 
Operational Reliability in Kwai Chung and Tseung Kwan O, Hong Kong
Veolia provides complete operational management for two major Digital Realty data centers. Through real-time monitoring and predictive maintenance, our teams ensure 99.999% uptime across a total managed area of 428,000 square feet.
Water Recycling with Amazon in Mississippi, United States
Our strategic partnership with Amazon demonstrates how to reduce the water footprint of a large-scale data center. This ambitious project, set to become operational in 2027, will leverage Veolia's autonomous treatment technologies to recycle more than 314 million liters of wastewater annually. 
These tangible achievements demonstrate that digital performance and environmental responsibility can go hand in hand. By transforming industrial waste streams into valuable resources for municipalities, Veolia is laying the foundations for a new industrial era in which infrastructure becomes a true partner to local communities .
Building a Responsible Digital Future Together 
As climate change accelerates, marked by devastating droughts and wildfires, there is a critical need to implement comprehensive resource management for digital development. The era when data centers could operate in isolated silos is over. The growth of digital infrastructure will depend on its ability to integrate intelligently into local communities.
Today, we must design projects that deliver measurable environmental and social value to local populations. Through circular economy opportunities, we enable operators to grow with confidence while protecting our precious ecosystems. The technologies exist, proven successes are already here, and the benefits for communities are undeniable. 
It is up to us to scale this virtuous model and make digital technology a true driver of the global ecological transition.
4 key takeaways from Veolia’s Data Center Resource 360 offering   
Reducing the water and carbon footprint of data centers while creating value for local communities. 
Integrated energy, water, and waste management, along with the circular economy, are at the heart of this offering, backed by proven solutions and international references. 
Societal acceptability and territorial resilience are ensured through a transparent, responsible approach aligned with stakeholders. 
Industrial operators and municipalities benefit from comprehensive support from permitting to operational performance to accelerate their sustainable digital strategy. 
Contact an expert 
Want to optimize your facilities' water and energy footprint? 
Our teams will guide you from the initial audit right through to implementation.

2 Tenants who host their servers, sharing a building's infrastructure.
3  Small data center infrastructure, typically located within a municipality rather than on the outskirts.

title: Press release: September 26, 2026 : Major drinking water services contract in Spain (112.5 KB)
content_text:
Veolia wins major €1 billion, 25-year
drinking water services contract in Spain
▁▁▁
Veolia announces that it has been selected as the winning bidder by The Metropolitan
Council of Barcelona for the landmark €1 billion, 25-year tender for the management of
essential drinking water services across eight municipalities in the Barcelona metropolitan
area, serving more than 230,000 residents. This contract will consolidate the Group’s long
lasting presence and commitment to Spain which is set to become its third-largest market in
the coming years.
At a time of growing pressure on water resources, climate resilience and household budgets,
Veolia’s winning offer combines deep local knowledge with global expertise and innovation to
deliver the highest-quality, most resilient service at the most competitive price, as reflected in
its top technical and economic evaluation.
“We are delighted with this outcome in Spain, a key country for Veolia and one where we
have been present for 160 years. We will put the best of our global expertise, technology
and innovation at the service of Barcelona and its communities, delivering best-in-class
services and the best value for money. Our ability to combine innovation and operational
efficiency will enable sustained investment in the quality and resilience of these essential
services, strengthening water resilience and environmental security over the long term.”
said, Estelle Brachalinoff, CEO of Veolia.
Among the planned improvements are a new sensor system for detecting leaks in the
network, the implementation of new digitized operations centers, the modernization of the
meter stock and the installation of remote meter reading equipment and the electrification of
the vehicle fleet, among others.
These actions, along with the rest included in the tender specifications, are essential for the
service and indispensable to provide water security to these municipalities, especially after
the episodes of severe drought that the region has experienced in recent years, so the
company's commitment is to start the work immediately.
The proposed ranking of bids, announced yesterday by the AMB and at the recommendation
of the Procurement Committee, following its plenary session, is a standard step in the
procedure and precedes the final award of the service contract.
About Veolia in Spain
With €3 billion in revenue and nearly 18,000 employees, Spain is a major growth engine for
Veolia, with more than 40% growth targeted by the end of the decade. Building on its
leadership in water, the Group plans to invest €1 billion in the country by 2030, across water
and other strategic activities including plastics recycling and energy recovery from waste.
▁▁▁
ABOUT VEOLIA
Veolia, a global leader in environmental services, works every day to build environmental security for the benefit
of public health and the competitiveness of industries and regions. With 215,000 employees across five
continents, working closely with local communities, and thanks to its cutting-edge technologies, the group cleans
up pollution, reduces carbon emissions, and regenerates resources through concrete solutions that combine its
expertise in water and water technologies, waste - including hazardous waste management, and local energy. In
2025, the Veolia group served 110 million people with drinking water and 97 million with sanitation, produced 45
million megawatt hours of energy, and treated 64 million tons of waste. Veolia Environnement (Paris Euronext:
VIE, Fortune 500, SBF 120) generated consolidated revenue of €44.4 billion in 2025. www.veolia.com

title: With BASF Ultramid® B3K, BOOXit Transport Boxes Meet the Demanding Requirements of Reusable Packaging Logistics
content_text:
With BASF Ultramid ® B3K, BOOXit Transport Boxes Meet the Demanding Requirements of Reusable Packaging Logistics
Lightweight and robust: BASF’s polyamide 6 supports a new circular packaging solution for professional transport. 
Ultramid ® B3K makes BOOXit boxes robust, durable and resistant to impact loads, even at very low temperatures.  
The reusable boxes can be stacked in offset configurations, rotated by 90°, handled by robotic systems and digitally connected to support efficient logistics operations. 
With Ultramid ® B3K BK00464 from BASF, the BOOXit transport box relies on a high-performance polyamide 6 designed for demanding logistics applications. The easy-flow material combines high strength, durability and efficient injection molding processing, characteristics that are particularly valuable for reusable transport boxes for use in parcel, healthcare, and industrial logistics. In the BOOXit box, the material is utilized in a digitally integrable, automation-ready reusable system designed to replace conventional single-use cardboard packaging and heavy metal transport containers. The BOOXit box has been designed as a modular system. It can be used with or without a lid, loaded from both the front and the top, features a patented locking mechanism, and is based on the standard 120 × 80 cm pallet footprint.
Ultramid ® B3K as the Basis for Robust Logistics Solutions 
Transport boxes for industrial and military applications must meet especially stringent requirements. They must withstand mechanical stress, offer long service life, be stackable, and perform reliably even under challenging environmental conditions.
This is precisely where Ultramid ® B3K demonstrates its strengths. The material is an easy-flow, stabilized and fast-processing injection molding grade based on PA6. Its combination of excellent processability and balanced mechanical properties makes it particularly suitable for large technical components.
“With Ultramid ® B3K, BASF supports our box solution, which combines several key requirements of modern logistics: robust mechanical performance, efficient processing, and the ability to implement intelligent reusable systems economically,” says Dr. Peter Entenfellner, CEO and Co-Founder of BOOXit. “When boxes are repeatedly used, stacked, transported and handled in automated systems, selecting the right material can make a decisive contribution to operational reliability.”
In addition to material performance, the BOOXit box also relies on intelligent design features. The CLICKit stacking system enables interlocked stacking, including at 90° angles for load securing purposes. Furthermore, boxes of different sizes can be stacked on top of one another.
Intelligent Reusable Logistics by Design 
The BOOXit box combines reusability with smart logistics. Moisture protection, continuous tracking, NFC-based identification, ERP integration and automation compatibility provide the foundation for efficient circular logistics systems. With a lifetime exceeding 100 transport cycles and 100% recyclability, the box also meets demanding requirements for sustainability and resource efficiency.
The reusable concept delivers advantages in both sustainability and cost efficiency. By replacing single-use cardboard packaging and enabling repeated use, the BOOXit box can significantly reduce resource consumption, waste generation and CO₂ emissions. At the same time, its long service life and efficient return logistics lower total lifecycle costs.
Looking ahead, robust, stackable and digitally connected reusable transport boxes also open new opportunities in professional medical and pharmaceutical logistics. Potential applications include packaging solutions for temperature-controlled transport of sensitive medical products, diagnostic materials and pharmaceutical supply chains.
Strong Injection-Molding Experience 
The BOOXit box is manufactured by POLYTEC GROUP, a plastics specialist with extensive expertise in producing large injection-molded components. The combination of material know-how and reliable large-part manufacturing processes forms the basis for the box’s high robustness and quality.
Premiere at Fakuma 2026 
The BOOXit transport box will be showcased for the first time at the BASF booth (B4-4303) during Fakuma 2026. Visitors will have the opportunity to experience the innovative reusable logistics solution firsthand and engage with experts to discuss material properties, application areas and the benefits of intelligent reusable transport systems.
 
About BASF  
At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 95,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of around €60 billion in 2025. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at  www.basf.com . 
About BASF’s Performance Materials division 
BASF’s Performance Materials division drives the transformation of the plastics industry by uniting sustainability with high performance. Our materials expertise, deep industry know-how, and broad product portfolio make us the preferred partner for comprehensive solutions across the plastics lifecycle. With dedicated material-focused teams, strong R&D power, and a global production network close to our customers, we deliver tailored offerings that meet regional and industry-specific needs. Our products enhance performance and efficiency in key sectors such as automotive, construction, consumer goods, and industrial applications. Together with our partners, we embark on #OurPlasticsJourney towards a more circular and sustainable future. In 2025, the Performance Materials division achieved global sales of €6.4 billion. 
Join #OurPlasticsJourney on LinkedIn  https://on.basf.com/PM_LinkedIn 
and in our newsletter  https://on.basf.com/PM_Newsletter . 
Further information at  https://www.performance-materials.basf.com .

Jenoptik secures major contract to deploy intersection safety camera systems across British Columbia
Jenoptik will deliver, implement and install more than 140 of the latest systems that combine red light violation and speed on green detection. 
24 September 2026 
JENOPTIK Canada Ltd., a leading provider of road safety and security solutions, has been awarded a contract by the Insurance Corporation of British Columbia (ICBC) to supply more than 140 intersection safety camera systems as part of ICBC’s Intersection Safety Camera Program. The project represents a significant investment in road safety infrastructure and supports ICBC’s ongoing efforts to improve safety at signalized intersections throughout British Columbia.
Under the terms of the agreement, Jenoptik will deliver, implement and install more than 140 of the latest systems that combine red light violation and speed on green detection, together with its FlowTris back-office platform. The integrated solution will support the capture, processing, and management of enforcement data, providing a secure and efficient workflow for administering the Intersection Safety Camera Program.
Intersection safety camera programs are designed to encourage safer driving behaviour by promoting compliance with traffic laws at signalized intersections. By helping to reduce high-risk driving behaviours, these systems contribute to safer roads for motorists, pedestrians, and cyclists. “We are proud to partner with ICBC in supporting its Intersection Safety Camera Program and its commitment to improving road safety across British Columbia,” said Candice Holder-Mattadeen, Head of Sales, JENOPTIK Canada Ltd. “With more than 20 years of experience delivering road safety solutions in Canada, we look forward to working with ICBC to implement a modern, reliable intersection safety camera program that helps improve safety for all road users.”
With this new partnership Jenoptik now has installations from coast-to-coast and their new office in Vancouver will bring more jobs to the community.
Jenoptik looks forward to supporting the successful deployment of the new intersection safety camera systems and contributing to safer communities across British Columbia.

About Jenoptik and its SBU Smart Mobility Solutions

title: 23-09-2026 | Case study Accelerating commercial vehicle electrification with reliable DC-DC converters​
content_text:
Accelerating commercial vehicle electrification with reliable DC-DC converters​
Electrification is transforming the commercial vehicle industry, but the path forward is not always straightforward. Manufacturers must balance regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and cost considerations while continuing to deliver reliable vehicles to the market. In this article, we explore how Avia Ingeniería y Diseño developed a practical micro-hybrid platform and the role that robust DC-DC conversion played in enabling its electrification journey. 
Electrification without complexity
Across Europe, commercial vehicle manufacturers are seeking ways to reduce emissions without the cost and complexity of full vehicle electrification. Hybrid architectures have emerged as a practical pathway, helping manufacturers improve sustainability while leveraging existing vehicle platforms. Supporting this transition requires more than electrified components alone. Reliable power conversion technologies play a critical role in enabling efficient vehicle architectures, reducing integration complexity, and accelerating development. The collaboration between Avia Ingeniería y Diseño and Prodrive Technologies demonstrates how proven power electronics can support practical electrification strategies while creating a foundation for future innovation
Prodrive's DC-DC converters
"One of the key advantages of working with Prodrive Technologies was the combination of a mature product and responsive engineering support. This allowed us to focus on system validation rather than solving component- level integration issues.​"  
David Sánchez​, CEO, Avia Ingeniería y Diseño​

content_text:
Safran invests in Akira, specialists in propulsion technology development and prototyping
Paris, September 22, 2026 
Media kit 
PR Safran Corporate Ventures Akira VEn VDef.pdf 
(PDF 0.23MB) 
Safran, through its corporate venture capital subsidiary Safran Corporate Ventures, today announced that it has acquired a minority stake in Akira as part of the company’s latest funding round. Safran joins existing investors MBDA and Definvest, an investment fund established by the French Defense Procurement Agency (DGA) and managed by French public investment bank Bpifrance. This strategic investment will support Akira’s growth plans and help consolidate a key industrial partnership.
Subscribe to press releases 
Founded in 2003 and located in Bayonne and Bergerac, France, Akira specializes in the design, prototyping and testing of high-performance propulsion systems and rotating machinery, including turbomachinery, piston engines, electric machines, transmissions, and pumps. 
Akira is already a Safran partner, collaborating actively with Safran Aircraft Engines, Safran Helicopter Engines and Safran Tech on major programs, including the development and testing of the RISE demonstrator, as well as other research and technology (R&T) projects focusing on hybridization and hydrogen combustion. Akira is also a key partner in the design and manufacture of test benches.
This funding round will enable Akira to accelerate its business growth and transition toward small- and medium-batch production, with a focus on three key priorities:
Expanding its production facilities and testing capabilities. 
Obtaining EN 9100 quality certification. 
Developing new market opportunities to scale up its activities in the drone propulsion and microturbine segments for defense applications. 
Florent Illat, CEO of Safran Corporate Ventures, commented: “Investing in Akira enables Safran to strengthen a longstanding relationship built on trust. Akira brings extensive expertise, especially in design, prototyping and agile development, which is essential to accelerating the development of technologies for the future of aviation and meeting the growing needs of the defense sector.”
Sylvain Loumé, Managing Director of Akira, said: “For a company working in mechanical engineering and engines, receiving such a vote of confidence from Safran is recognition of the expertise and efficiency of the Akira team. It also represents a further tangible commitment on our part to building a French industrial sector that combines technological excellence, sovereignty and competitiveness.”

Turning functional fixtures into design-forward accents made to be seen 
ST. PAUL, Minn. , Sept. 21, 2026 / PRNewswire / -- For decades, Command™ Brand has been known for making trusted hanging solutions that are designed to blend seamlessly into the background. Now, Command Brand is stepping to the forefront of home design with the Command™ DÉCOR Collection , a new line of premium metal fixtures created to be seen, not hidden.
Inspired by the growing desire to make every detail of a home feel intentional, the collection brings together real metal construction, sophisticated gallery-inspired finishes and Command Brand's signature damage-free hanging technology. The result turns everyday fixtures into purposeful design accents that add style and function to any space.
"The Command DÉCOR Collection represents an evolution for Command Brand, bringing together the function consumers know and love with design they'll want to show off," said Tate Galvin, global vice president, Home Improvement, 3M. "We know consumers want their spaces to feel personal and thoughtfully designed, down to the smallest details. With the DÉCOR Collection, we're making it possible to express that personal style while still delivering the practicality and versatility Command Brand is known for."
Available in Brushed Brass, Light Beige, Matte Black and Chrome, the Command DÉCOR Collection transforms functional fixtures into elevated design accents for every room. From creating a welcoming entryway and displaying curated collections to bringing greenery to an empty wall or creating a spa-inspired bathroom, the collection offers versatile solutions that make function part of the design.
The collection includes:
Command Large and Small Metal Hooks: Refined solutions for hanging coats, bags, hats, accessories and jewelry, ideal for creating an elevated entryway.
Command Metal Wall Planter: A stylish way to bring greenery to walls, complete with a removable plastic insert for easy watering.
Command Metal Key Rail: A sleek, tool-free solution for keeping keys organized and within reach.
Command Metal Wall Shelf: A durable display and storage solution for curated décor, keepsakes and everyday essentials.
Command Large Towel Hook and Small Robe Hook: Water-resistant bath organizers that bring a polished, spa-inspired aesthetic to the bathroom.
Made with quality cast metal, each fixture delivers a premium look and feel while providing the strength needed for everyday hanging and organizing. Small hooks support up to 2 pounds, while larger hooks and shelves support up to 5 pounds. Each fixture also uses Command Brand's damage-free hanging technology, allowing consumers to hang items securely without nails, screws or tools and remove them without leaving marks or holes. This makes it easy to reorganize, refresh a space or adapt to life's next chapter without compromising on style.
The Command DÉCOR Collection is now available at retailers nationwide and online.
Explore the full collection and find design inspiration at www.command.com/decor or follow @Command on Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, and Facebook for styling ideas and the latest design trends.

For over 30 years, the Command™ Brand has been the leader in damage-free hanging and organization solutions. With innovative adhesive technology and thoughtfully designed products, Command™ Brand empowers people to personalize their spaces without compromise—whether they own, rent, or are just beginning to design their own spaces. From picture hanging to organizational solutions, Command™ Products are trusted by millions of homeowners, renters, and students worldwide. Learn more at Command.com.

title: BASF evaluates MDI investment in India
content_text:
BASF evaluates MDI investment in India
BASF is evaluating a potential investment in India as part of its continued commitment to serving growing customer demand in the region. The company is in the advanced stages of a feasibility study for the construction of an MDI (methylene diphenyl diisocyanate) production complex and has secured an industrial land parcel in Dahej, Gujarat, for the potential investment through its Indian subsidiary, BASF India Polyurethanes Private Limited. MDI is a key building block for polyurethane products used in applications ranging from building insulation and refrigeration to automotive components, furniture and consumer goods.
“India is among the most attractive growth markets globally, with strong demand expected across a wide range of industries,” said Dr. Stephan Kothrade, member of the Board of Executive Directors and Chief Technology Officer of BASF SE. “In line with our ‘Winning Ways’ strategy, we are focusing on investments that strengthen our core businesses and create long-term value. A potential investment in India would further expand our manufacturing footprint in a key growth market and, consistent with our local-for-local approach, enable us to serve customers in India and neighboring markets with locally produced MDI.”
The final investment decision will be based on the outcome of the feasibility study and will remain subject to all necessary approvals. 
“BASF continues to invest in its global MDI production network to support customer growth and ensure reliable supply across key markets,” said Dr. Ramkumar Dhruva, President of BASF’s Monomers division. “While the commissioning of our $1 billion MDI expansion project in Geismar is entering its final phase, we are evaluating the next potential step in strengthening our global MDI footprint. A project in India would complement our existing production network and further enhance supply reliability for our customers.” 
In addition to Geismar, United States, BASF operates MDI production facilities in Antwerp, Belgium; Chongqing and Caojing (Shanghai), China; and Yeosu, South Korea.
India has been part of BASF’s growth story for more than 130 years. Today, the company operates multiple production sites across the country, serving customers in a broad range of industries. At its integrated chemical complex in Dahej, BASF India Limited already operates an MDI splitter and polyurethane production facilities, making the location a strong foundation for further growth. As India’s urbanization, infrastructure development and manufacturing activities continue to accelerate, demand for high-performance materials is expected to grow.
 
About BASF 
At BASF, we create chemistry for a sustainable future. Our ambition: We want to be the preferred chemical company to enable our customers’ green transformation. We combine economic success with environmental protection and social responsibility. Around 95,000 employees in the BASF Group contribute to the success of our customers in nearly all sectors and almost every country in the world. Our portfolio comprises, as core businesses, the segments Chemicals, Materials, Industrial Solutions, and Nutrition & Care; our standalone businesses are bundled in the segments Surface Technologies and Agricultural Solutions. BASF generated sales of around €60 billion in 2025. BASF shares are traded on the stock exchange in Frankfurt (BAS) and as American Depositary Receipts (BASFY) in the United States. Further information at  www.basf.com .
 
About BASF in India 
BASF is well rooted in India and has successfully partnered India’s progress for more than 130 years. As of the end of 2025, BASF had 2,435 employees in India with 8 production sites and more than 40 offices throughout the country. The Innovation Campus Mumbai is part of BASF’s global technology platform. In 2025, BASF registered sales of approximately €2.3 billion to customers in India. Further information is available on  www.basf.com/in .

title: Sep. 19, 2026 Business & Products Sumitomo Chemical Signs a Memorandum of Understanding with Tata Electronics to Explore Potential Collaboration on Semiconductor Materials in India

content_text:
Sumitomo Chemical Signs a Memorandum of Understanding with Tata Electronics to Explore Potential Collaboration on Semiconductor Materials in India
Sep. 19, 2026
Sumitomo Chemical has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (“MoU”) with Tata Electronics Private Limited (“Tata Electronics”) to explore the possibility of collaborating to build a semiconductor supply chain in India. Under the MoU, Sumitomo Chemical will examine specific measures aimed at establishing a stable supply system for semiconductor materials, including the potential establishment of a semiconductor chemicals facility in India.
The Indian government is promoting the development of the semiconductor industry as a national strategic priority. Against this backdrop, Tata Electronics is advancing the construction of India’s first front-end semiconductor fabrication plant. As India’s markets for semiconductors and related materials are expected to grow, Sumitomo Chemical believes that this construction project being undertaken by Tata Electronics will help strengthen the foundation of the country’s semiconductor industry.
The Sumitomo Chemical Group has positioned its ICT & Mobility Solutions sector as one of its growth drivers and designated its semiconductor materials business as a priority area within the sector. The Group provides a broad range of products, including advanced photoresists and semiconductor chemicals. In particular, it has established a leading position in high-purity chemicals and earned the trust of advanced semiconductor manufacturers through its ultra-high-purity technologies, quality assurance systems underpinned by advanced analytical technologies, and global supply capabilities.
The Sumitomo Chemical Group has been expanding the global business footprint of its semiconductor chemicals business through various initiatives. These include growing its production capacity in Japan and South Korea, establishing a new base in Texas, the United States, in 2022, and acquiring Asia Union Electronic Chemical Corporation in 2026, which operates manufacturing facilities in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, and Nevada, the United States. In addition to expanding the scale of its business, the Group has commenced operations at Advanced High-Purity Chemical Centers in Japan and South Korea in 2026, where it is advancing the development of highly productive processes and recycling technologies, and other related technologies. Going forward, by exploring potential collaboration with Tata Electronics, the Group will accelerate its assessment of business opportunities in the Indian market.
Sumitomo Chemical Group hopes that, should the collaboration be realized, it will contribute to the development of India’s semiconductor ecosystem.

title: 09/18/2026 JSR and IBM's joint research outcome have been accepted for publication in Nature Computational Science
content_text:
JSR and IBM's joint research outcome have been accepted for publication in Nature Computational Science
09/18/2026 
Corporate 
JSR Corporation (Representative Director, President & CEO: Tetsuro Hori, hereinafter "JSR") and IBM today announced that a joint research outcome from their collaborative AI research program for the chemical industry has been accepted for publication in Nature Computational Science . The collaboration is being conducted under a Joint Research Agreement (JRA) between the two organizations. Nature Computational Science , published by Nature Portfolio, is a leading international scientific journal featuring research that applies computational science to address complex challenges across natural sciences, engineering, and related disciplines.
The published research combines IBM's expertise in AI and algorithms with JSR's deep knowledge of chemistry and materials science to achieve both high predictive accuracy and interpretability in the prediction of material properties for organic materials.
The method developed through this research leverages topological distance information within molecules, enabling it to capture complex structural characteristics of entire molecules that are difficult to represent using conventional approaches. Researchers from both organizations validated the predictions generated by the method through molecular orbital analysis. The results demonstrated superior performance compared with representative existing methods in predicting the optical properties of complex dye molecules, while also providing chemically interpretable explanations for the predictions. The research findings offer new insights for foundation models that handle complex molecular structures as well as for quantum chemistry calculations. Looking ahead, the approach is expected to contribute to more efficient materials development and the discovery of promising material candidates through applications in materials screening and molecular design.
Takeshi Fukuda, Executive Officer, Head of Research & Development, and Director of IBM Research - Tokyo, IBM Japan, said: "This achievement marks an important step forward in Material DX, where AI and materials experts work together to accelerate the discovery of new materials. Through our continued collaboration with JSR, we are committed to advancing materials development technologies by leveraging AI and quantum computing."
Toru Kimura, Senior Executive Officer, Head of Electronic Materials Business, Next Generation Research (DS/MI, etc.), JSR Corporation, said: "This achievement is significant, demonstrating the unprecedented potential of integrating AI and materials science in materials development. JSR will further enhance its research and development process, from materials exploration and design to experimentation and verification, by combining its long-cultivated materials expertise with cutting-edge digital technologies, including AI. Moving forward, through advanced initiatives and partnership with IBM, we aim to dramatically increase the speed and quality of development to deliver materials with new value to society more quickly."
As emerging technologies and digital transformation continue to accelerate, JSR and IBM are working together to help lead a new era of technological and societal advancement. JSR's materials innovation in the semiconductor field forms part of the backbone of a wide range of industries, helping enable a more connected world through technologies that are seamlessly integrated into everyday life.
Title: Revisiting Molecular Descriptors with TDiMS for Interpretable Intramolecular Interactions Based on Substructure Pairs 
Authors: Lisa Hamada¹, Akihiro Kishimoto¹, Kohei Miyaguchi¹, Yoshitaka Hirose², Junta Fuchiwaki², Indra Priyadarsini¹, and Seiji Takeda¹
¹ IBM Research ² JSR Corporation
Publication URL: https://www.nature.com/articles/s43588-026-01036-3

title: Charles River Leverages Expertise in Rapid and In Vitro Methods to Reduce Cell Banking Timelines
source: Charles River - News Releases / Press Releases

View printer-friendly version 
Charles River Leverages Expertise in Rapid and In Vitro Methods to Reduce Cell Banking Timelines
PDF Version 
Charles River platform offers 40% reduction in cell bank production timeline, over the industry standard of 20 weeks 
WILMINGTON, Mass. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Sep. 17, 2026--
Charles River Laboratories International, Inc. (NYSE: CRL) has introduced rapid cell banking programs designed to significantly accelerate release timelines, enabling biopharmaceutical and advanced therapy developers   to reach critical milestones faster and bring innovative treatments to patients sooner. By combining rapid cell bank and release packages with advanced characterization using Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), Charles River delivers a comprehensive, end-to-end solution that enhances product quality, safety, and regulatory readiness while reducing overall development timelines.
“By leveraging our long-standing expertise in rapid test methods, we can expedite pre-bank and release testing timelines, enabling clients to establish and characterize cell banks quickly and move their product forward in development,” said Matthew Hewitt , Corporate Vice President, Chief Technology Officer, Manufacturing, Charles River. "The integration of rapid cell banking with NGS technologies provides a powerful advantage for developers, helping accelerate critical milestones, de-risk development programs, and ultimately bring innovative therapies to patients faster."
At every stage of the process, Charles River provides deep regulatory rigor and support, helping clients navigate the complexities of biologic and advanced therapy development, align with global regulatory expectations, and efficiently progress programs from early development through commercialization.
This platform offering further advances the Company's commitment to the 3Rs (Replacement, Reduction, Refinement) through its Alternative Methods Advancement Project™ (AMAP™), which develops and implements alternative methods and other innovative strategies to reduce reliance on animal testing while supporting efficient product development.
Established Expertise in Delivering Rapid Test Methods
To accelerate the establishment of cell banks, Charles River offers rapid microbiological methods (RMM) for microbial detection (including Celsis ® ATP-Bioluminescence technology) and rapid mycoplasma detection using real-time PCR. These technologies replace traditional compendial testing with automated, objective results, resulting in faster pre-bank, and release testing timelines.
Leveraging In Vitro Techniques for Next-Generation Sequencing
Following the establishment of cell banks, Charles River can leverage NGS, via our iDTECT ® platform, to provide reliable in vitro characterization services. NGS is revolutionizing how cell banks and advanced therapeutics are characterized and tested, ensuring high-quality products are delivered to patients. NGS has transformed the landscape of genetic analysis and pathogen detection with its scalability, speed, and broad viral detection capabilities.
“Cell bank characterization is a critical foundation for the development of biologic products, and NGS is transforming how the industry approaches safety and quality testing,” said Colette Côté, Executive Director & Scientific Advisor, Global Biologics Testing Services , Charles River. “By combining rapid cell banking capabilities with NGS as part of the cell bank characterization package, we help clients accelerate development timelines while generating the comprehensive data needed to support regulatory submissions and build confidence in product quality and safety."
Charles River’s CGMP-compliant NGS testing services accelerate development timelines without compromising safety, while meeting stringent global regulatory expectations for accuracy, reliability, and compliance, including GMP requirements and regulatory guidance from the FDA and EMA along with ICH Q5A and Q5B. The Company's acquisition of Pathoquest, a recognized leader in NGS solutions for in vitro characterization and quality control testing of biopharmaceutical products, further strengthens these capabilities. By integrating Pathoquest’s expertise and technology platform, Charles River delivers faster, more advanced sequencing-based testing solutions, enabling clients to move efficiently through development while maintaining confidence in product quality, safety, and regulatory readiness.
About the Alternative Methods Advancement Project (AMAP)
The Alternative Methods Advancement Project (AMAP) is a Charles River-led initiative dedicated to developing New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) and exploring innovative scientific and technological solutions aimed at reducing reliance on traditional animal testing. As we enter the next frontier of drug development, AMAP enables strategic, purpose-driven investment to shape a future in which more patients can access the treatments and medicines they need safely, swiftly, and successfully. AMAP is supported by our global, cross-functional Scientific Advisory Board led by Dr. Namandjé N. Bumpus .
About Charles River
Charles River provides essential products and services to help pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, government agencies and leading academic institutions around the globe accelerate their research and drug development efforts. Our dedicated employees are focused on providing clients with exactly what they need to improve and expedite the discovery, early-stage development and safe manufacture of new therapies for the patients who need them. To learn more about our unique portfolio and breadth of services, visit www.criver.com .

Prodrive Technologies begins shipping Runix-MX105 high-performance machine vision camera
SCIENCE PARK EINDHOVEN, THE NETHERLANDS. (17 September, 2026) 
Prodrive Technologies announces the upcoming customer shipments of the new  Runix- MX105 high speed camera the first camera in the Runix product family. Designed for demanding semiconductor and industrial imaging applications, the camera combines ultra-high resolution with high-speed image acquisition in a compact and robust platform. The Runix-MX105 features the Sony IMX927 - 105-megapixel image sensor and delivers up to  112 frames per second, a perfect solution for high-speed inspection applications in the semiconductor and FPD industry as well as process monitoring, motion analysis, and scientific imaging.
The launch marks an important milestone in the development of the Runix series and expands Prodrive Technologies' portfolio of advanced machine vision solutions for high-performance inspection and metrology applications.
First public demonstration at VISION Stuttgart
The Runix-MX105 will be demonstrated publicly for the first time at Vision Stuttgart 2026 , where visitors can experience the camera's performance firsthand and discuss application opportunities with Prodrive Technologies' imaging specialists. Visit us in  Hall 10, Booth 10E59  to see the Runix-MX105 in action and learn how it can support next-generation machine vision and semiconductor inspection applications.

title: TOPPAN Group Inaugurates New BOPP Film Manufacturing Line at Irplast in Italy
content_text:
TOPPAN Group Inaugurates New BOPP Film Manufacturing Line at Irplast in Italy
Enhancing supply capabilities using simultaneous biaxial orientation technology to bolster global supply of sustainable solutions
Tweet 
Tokyo – September 17, 2026 – TOPPAN Inc. (TOPPAN), a TOPPAN Group company and wholly owned subsidiary of TOPPAN Holdings Inc. (TYO: 7911), and its Italy-based film manufacturing subsidiary Irplast S.p.A. (Irplast), today announced the inauguration of a new manufacturing line for high-performance biaxially oriented polypropylene (BOPP) films, marking the occasion with a ceremony on September 15, 2026.
An overview of this development will be included at the TOPPAN booth (East Hall 2, Booth No. 2R10) during TOKYO PACK 2026, to be held at Tokyo Big Sight from Wednesday, October 14 to Friday, October 16, 2026.
Background and Objectives
In its packaging business, the TOPPAN Group is accelerating the establishment of its global supply network for recycle-ready mono-material packaging to meet tightening environmental regulations - such as the EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) - and to drive the transition toward a circular economy.
Irplast, a TOPPAN Group company, is a premium film manufacturer equipped with advanced simultaneous biaxial orientation technology. Its unique expertise in minimizing thermal shrinkage provides BOPP films with exceptional heat resistance, mechanical strength, and superior transparency.
Through the operation of this line, together with existing capabilities, the plant will be able to establish an overall supply infrastructure of up to 30,000 tonnes per year for high-performance BOPP films. This deployment expands the TOPPAN Group’s production capabilities and enhances manufacturing efficiency, ensuring a stable, local supply to meet the surging demand for sustainable packaging in Europe and beyond.
Features of the New Manufacturing Line
・Developing High-Value Applications through Simultaneous Orientation Technology: 
The films produced on this line offer uniform physical properties and high dimensional stability achieved through the LISIM 1 simultaneous stretching process. Leveraging this robustness, TOPPAN and Irplast will actively develop high-end packaging applications that require durability even under demanding conditions, such as retort sterilization.
・Reducing Environmental Impact through Package Down Gauging: 
Utilizing the film’s superior mechanical strength, development will be focused toward "down gauging" (reducing film thickness). This enables a steady and continuous reduction in plastic consumption while maintaining essential packaging functions, directly supporting resource conservation goals.
Future Activities
The new line is expected to commence full commercial operations by late 2026, supplying high-performance BOPP films to packaging converters and global brand owners.
The combination of Irplast’s BOPP film manufacturing expertise and the TOPPAN Group’s broad base of technologies and solutions will expand sustainable solutions worldwide by driving use as a next-generation substrate in transparent GL BARRIER 2 films as well as unlocking new possibilities for high-performance, sustainable packaging solutions that contribute to a circular economy.
1 LISIM is Bruckner’s simultaneous stretching technology utilized by Irplast.
URL: https://www.irplast.com/bopp-film-division/ 
2 GL BARRIER is TOPPAN’s proprietary brand of transparent film products that deliver world-class barrier performance. Stable performance is enabled by a multi-layer structure combining a unique coating layer with a high-quality vapor-deposited layer. In recognition of their numerous outstanding features, GL BARRIER products are used in a wide variety of fields, including the food, healthcare/pharmaceutical, and industrial materials sectors. Combining the functions of the printing and barrier substrate layers into a single layer provides an alternative to aluminum foil with a streamlined layer structure.
https://www.toppan.com/en/living-industry/packaging/products/barrier_film/ 
About the TOPPAN Group
Established in Tokyo in 1900, the TOPPAN Group is a leading and diversified global provider committed to delivering sustainable, integrated solutions in fields including printing, communications, security, packaging, décor materials, electronics, and digital transformation. The TOPPAN Group’s global team of more than 50,000 employees offers optimal solutions enabled by industry-leading expertise and technologies to address the diverse challenges of every business sector and society and contribute to the achievement of shared sustainability goals.

title: onsemi Charts Path to Power the Next Decade of Innovation
content_text:
onsemi Charts Path to Power the Next Decade of Innovation
September 16, 2026 at 2:30 PM EDT
PDF Version 
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Wafer
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Wafer
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Chip
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Chip
Company outlines a $213 billion market opportunity as power becomes the foundational technology layer from infrastructure to physical applications
SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- onsemi (NASDAQ: ON) today outlined its long-term growth strategy to lead one of the largest and most consequential technology shifts of the next decade by solving the growing power constraints limiting the advancement of AI, electrification and automation. As these markets converge around common technology requirements, onsemi is leveraging its differentiated portfolio across power and sensing to address a $213 billion market opportunity and solve the needs of some of the most important technology trends shaping the global economy.
“Every transformational technology eventually encounters a physical constraint. As AI, electrification and automation continue to scale, power density is emerging as one of the defining engineering challenges of this decade,” said Hassane El-Khoury, President and CEO of onsemi. “The companies that lead in the next era of innovation will be those that can deliver more energy while consuming less space. As that challenge becomes more urgent, power has become a foundational technology layer that will help shape the pace of innovation, economic growth and global competitiveness. We have spent years building deep expertise and a broad portfolio across power and sensing to help customers solve this challenge and enable the next generation of intelligent machines.”
Unlocking a $213 Billion Opportunity 
onsemi sees a $213 billion total addressable market by 2030 spanning automotive, industrial, AI data center and emerging applications. Although these markets are often viewed separately, they increasingly rely on the same underlying capabilities: efficient power conversion, perception of the physical world, precision actuation and control, and connectivity.
This convergence allows onsemi to deploy common technology platforms across multiple end markets. A high-voltage technology developed for automotive electrification, for example, can also support industrial energy systems and AI data centers. Advances in sensing and connectivity can extend across vehicles, factories, robotics, medical systems and other autonomous applications.
The company expects this platform-based model to increase the revenue potential of its core technologies by moving from individual components to higher-value solutions and system architectures that address a larger share of each customer's design requirements. Through this approach, onsemi can generate greater leverage from its R&D investments, reduce dependence on any single end market or technology cycle, and grow faster than the markets it serves.
“Throughout history, foundational technologies have created outsized value because they enable everything built above them,” El-Khoury said. “Power has become the common denominator across these end markets. For onsemi, that creates opportunities to innovate beyond any market trend, with multiple paths to expand content, gain share and capture more value.”
Solving the Next Challenge: Power Density 
Capturing this opportunity requires addressing a growing constraint facing AI infrastructure and other intelligent systems – power density – or the ability to deliver greater performance and capability using less energy and less physical space.
Increasing power density requires electrical, thermal, mechanical and physical performance to be optimized simultaneously. Increasing power typically generates more heat, while reducing system size can make that heat more difficult to remove. Improving efficiency may require new materials, device architectures and integration methods. Historically, these trade-offs forced system designers to make compromises among power, size, cost and thermal performance.
As these challenges become more complex, value increasingly shifts to companies that can optimize across the entire system. onsemi has expanded beyond traditional power semiconductors to build capabilities spanning technologies, products, solutions and systems. onsemi highlighted three technology platforms that will shape the next generation of intelligent systems and drive long-term growth across its key end markets:
High-Voltage Technologies: The Device Layer
onsemi's high-voltage portfolio spans silicon, silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN), giving customers a range of options to optimize performance, efficiency, power density and cost. The portfolio includes vertical gallium nitride (vGaN), a differentiated technology, exclusive to onsemi, designed for next-generation high-voltage applications that can increase efficiency, improve switching performance and reduce system size where conventional power technologies are reaching their limits.
Treo: The Intelligence Layer
Modern systems must do more than convert power. They must monitor operating conditions, communicate across the system, respond to changing loads and protect critical functions in real-time. The Treo platform’s high precision analog, high density digital and high voltage capabilities, enable systems to become more precise, adaptive and autonomous. This allows onsemi to add these capabilities around the power device, increasing the functionality and value within a customer’s system.
Embedded Power Platform (EPP): The Integration Layer
EPP reimagines the package from passive housing into an active contributor to system performance. By using the silicon wafer itself as the package, EPP enables the seamless integration and interconnection of silicon, SiC and GaN technologies within a highly integrated wafer-level architecture. Multiple devices, including FETs, drivers and controllers, can be embedded together in a single package and co-optimized for electrical, thermal and mechanical performance. This enables complete power-system co-design, allowing electrical, thermal and mechanical characteristics to be evaluated and optimized together from day one. The result is higher power density, improved system performance, reduced development complexity and faster time-to-market.
As customers increasingly seek complete solutions rather than individual components, onsemi solves a larger portion of the customer’s challenge by reducing design complexity and accelerating development across automotive, industrial, AI data center and emerging applications. With this focus on the entire system-level solution, onsemi creates a competitive advantage that is difficult to replicate through individual components alone.
Beyond the Data Center: AI's Next Frontier is the Physical World 
While today's AI investments are largely focused on building the infrastructure needed to train and run increasingly sophisticated models, the next phase of growth will occur at the edge, where intelligence moves beyond the data center into machines that interact directly with the physical world.
These physical AI systems must sense, decide, act and adapt safely in real-world environments, in real-time. Whether deployed in a robot, vehicle, factory, medical system or autonomous platform, each system requires four capabilities to operate together:
Power to provide the energy foundation that enables intelligent systems to operate
Sense to perceive and understand the physical environment
Control to execute decisions through precise real-world actions
Connected Compute to process, share and continuously adapt information at the edge
As this transition happens, many of these same technologies onsemi developed for automotive and industrial applications can be applied to this emerging market. onsemi's ability to combine these capabilities through system-level co-design and optimize performance across the full stack, positions it to deliver differentiated solutions and capture a larger share of the value created by physical AI.
“The most attractive opportunities of the next decade are emerging as markets converge around the same technologies,” El-Khoury said. “The ability to efficiently deliver power, sense the environment and enable intelligent decision-making will define the next generation of intelligent machines. Our differentiated technology platforms enable us to solve power density across the device, intelligence and integration layers in a way no other semiconductor company can, positioning us to expand our content and grow as AI moves from infrastructure into the physical world.”

title: onsemi Introduces the Embedded Power Platform, a Breakthrough Architecture for the AI Era
content_text:
onsemi Introduces the Embedded Power Platform, a Breakthrough Architecture for the AI Era
September 16, 2026 at 2:30 PM EDT
PDF Version 
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Chip
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Chip
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Wafer
onsemi Embedded Power Platform Wafer
Platform uses silicon wafer itself as the package and introduces a highly integrated approach to power system design across automotive, industrial, and AI data center markets
Summary: onsemi today unveiled the Embedded Power Platform (EPP), redefining system power delivery through unprecedented power density and integration of multiple dies into a single silicon device. By jointly optimizing electrical, mechanical and thermal performance within a single architecture, EPP enables up to 3 – 5x higher power density compared with current solutions with a highly integrated approach to power system design. This helps customers reduce complexity while scaling for the increasing demands of AI infrastructure and electrification.
SCOTTSDALE, Ariz., Sept. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- onsemi today unveiled the Embedded Power Platform (EPP), a breakthrough architecture that uses the silicon wafer itself as the foundation of the package and introduces a highly integrated approach to power system design. Designed as a scalable platform, EPP brings electrical, mechanical and thermal design together from the outset to help customers achieve higher power density, improve system performance and accelerate development in AI, electrification and autonomous applications.
“For decades, the semiconductor and the package have been treated as separate technologies. EPP changes that by making the silicon itself part of the system architecture,” said Hassane El-Khoury, President and CEO of onsemi. “EPP brings together advanced semiconductor technologies, manufacturing and system-level optimization into a common architecture that can evolve alongside future innovations. This approach can redefine how power systems are built and create a new foundation for AI infrastructure, electrification and automation.”
What’s New: EPP reimagines the package from passive housing into an active contributor to system performance. By using the silicon wafer itself as the package, EPP enables the seamless integration and interconnection of silicon, silicon carbide (SiC) and gallium nitride (GaN) technologies within a highly integrated wafer-level architecture. Multiple devices, including FETs, drivers and controllers, can be embedded together in a single package and co-optimized for electrical, thermal and mechanical performance. This enables complete power-system co-design, allowing electrical, thermal and mechanical characteristics to be evaluated and optimized together from day one. The result is higher power density, improved system performance, reduced development complexity and faster time-to-market.
EPP also leverages onsemi’s standard 12-inch silicon wafer manufacturing capabilities, bringing key integration processes into the precision and control of the semiconductor fab. This applies mature semiconductor design tools, wafer-level manufacturing and advanced simulation capabilities to power-system integration, helping improve performance while accelerating innovation.
Subaru Corporation is one of the first early engagement partners for EPP, working with onsemi to evaluate how the platform could support future electrified vehicle architectures. Through the collaboration, Subaru will gain early access to engineering samples, simulation models and technical expertise as the companies explore opportunities to improve vehicle performance, streamline development and accelerate innovation.
Why It Matters: AI infrastructure, electrified transportation, industrial automation are all competing for the same critical resource: power. Customers need to move and manage more electricity within increasingly compact systems while controlling heat, efficiency, cost and development time. Yet many of today's power systems are still developed using traditional design approaches that treat power electronics, mechanical design and thermal design as separate engineering challenges, with each layer optimized independently and sequentially. Decisions made at one stage can create compromises in another, leading to additional engineering iterations, costly late-stage changes and longer development cycles.
EPP replaces that sequential model with a common platform that can be co-designed, co-simulated and co-optimized. This approach is designed to help customers:
Achieve 3 – 5x higher power density, depending on the application
Accelerate development cycles to as little as four months
Improve thermal performance and heat dissipation
Reduce electrical losses through lower parasitic inductance
Enable greater device control and higher switching frequencies
Identify design trade-offs earlier and reduce costly late-stage changes
Scale a common architecture across power levels, device types, applications semiconductor technologies
AI Infrastructure Applications: As AI rack power increases, more space and cooling capacity must be dedicated to the systems that deliver, convert and protect that power. This can limit how much compute capacity can fit within a rack. In an early EPP-based solid-state circuit-breaker design, the solution was approximately 50% smaller and 20% cooler than existing designs. By reducing packaging overhead and using the full EPP footprint to conduct heat, EPP can support more compact power systems, improve thermal management and enable greater power density in AI infrastructure.
Electric Vehicle Applications: Electric vehicle traction inverters are often constrained by efficiency losses, thermal limitations, development complexity and system size. EPP addresses these challenges with up to 4x higher power density and 15% lower power losses compared to conventional approaches, enabling smaller, lighter and more efficient inverter designs. Its scalable architecture supports a single inverter platform spanning low-end to high-end vehicle applications, allowing automakers to reuse a common design across multiple vehicle models and power classes. This approach can reduce R&D and manufacturing costs, accelerate qualification and development cycles, improve vehicle range or lower system costs, and help bring new vehicle programs to market faster.
The AI era is creating new infrastructure challenges that cannot be solved by computing power alone. As power becomes one of the defining constraints on future innovation, EPP represents a fundamentally new approach to how energy is delivered, managed and optimized. By turning the silicon wafer into the package itself, onsemi is establishing a foundation for the next generation of AI, electrification and autonomous systems.
Availability: EPP is expected to begin sampling in 2026 with strategic customers and ecosystem participants across automotive and AI applications.

content_text:
Industry leaders scale full value chain for hydrogen mobility across Europe
Paris, France, 
September 15, 2026 
News
Group
Hydrogen
Today at IAA Transportation, Volvo Group, Daimler Truck, Toyota Motor Corporation, Bosch, Air Liquide, TotalEnergies, TEAL Mobility, and MB Energy unveiled their plans to accelerate the rollout of hydrogen-powered vehicles across Europe. For the first time in Europe, the German ecosystem has put in place all the conditions for a scalable deployment of hydrogen trucks by 2030, driven by the German authorities and European industrial leaders along the value chain. Building on the German deployment model as a blueprint, scaling these solutions across the continent calls for aligned support from national governments and the European Commission to ensure long-term energy resilience and competitiveness. 
Rooted in the shared conviction that hydrogen is an important complement to battery-electric vehicles in achieving the EU’s decarbonization targets, industry leaders are joining forces to overcome historical bottlenecks, particularly for truck operations requiring long range, high payload capacity, rapid refueling and operational flexibility. At Daimler Truck, customers have driven almost 600,000 kilometers with fuel cell trucks. As the next step, the company plans to deploy a small series of 100 next generation fuel cell trucks into customer operations from the end of 2026 onwards. In parallel, the first hydrogen combustion engine trucks (H2 ICE) are being prepared for market launch next year. Overall, the company invests a mid-three-digit million euro amount in hydrogen trucks by the end of the decade. Volvo Group is similarly advancing its hydrogen portfolio and investing significant amounts into hydrogen power solutions such as both fuel-cell and hydrogen-combustion trucks for market rollout towards 2030. Toyota will participate as a technology partner supporting the expansion of hydrogen mobility, leveraging more than 30 years of expertise gained through the development and supply of fuel cell systems, while Bosch is supplying key vehicle components for gaseous hydrogen - with its fuel cell system proven over more than 30 million kilometers on the road - alongside breakthrough refueling technologies for both liquid and gaseous hydrogen. 
On the energy and infrastructure side, Volvo Group and Daimler Truck are closely cooperating with energy companies and hydrogen suppliers like Air Liquide, TotalEnergies and MB Energy, and retail operators such as MB Energy and TEAL Mobility (a 50/50 joint venture between TotalEnergies and Air Liquide, operating under the TotalEnergies brand). These players are mobilizing their respective capacities to scale both liquid and gaseous hydrogen supply chains. Through their infrastructure investments, they are advancing toward large capacity, high-throughput refueling stations, able to refuel up to 100 trucks per day. They are also leveraging synergies with the fast-growing industrial renewable hydrogen production, driven by the implementation of the European RED III directive. Reaching competitive costs with diesel is essential for fleet operators to adopt hydrogen. Crucially, combining German government policies with industrial collaboration makes this possible through three key levers: 
Lowering truck cost through incentives and series production. 
Reaching diesel competitive hydrogen pump price through a more competitive hydrogen supply chain and Greenhouse Gas quota mechanisms. 
Offering operating incentives like zero emission toll exemptions for fleet operators. 
Market is rising to meet these conditions. Recent applications under Germany's NOW funding program were oversubscribed, with over 70 high-capacity stations and 800 heavy-duty trucks applied for by industrial companies, confirming strong commercial pull from the logistics sector. 
While Germany serves as the operational launchpad, demonstrating how industry action and targeted public support can accelerate market development, the industry leaders are calling for strategic measures – supported by national governments and the European Commission – to replicate this model at a continental scale. 
These measures include scaling infrastructure through synchronized funding calls for refueling stations and vehicles to meet Alternative Fuels Infrastructure Regulation (AFIR) targets; strengthening the commercial viability of hydrogen through pragmatic, harmonized renewable fuel credit mechanisms and toll incentives; and jointly de-risking the overall value chain, from production and liquefaction to final distribution and vehicle operation. 
This combination of industrial execution and a strong policy framework provides the foundation needed to scale zero-emission freight while reinforcing Europe’s industrial competitiveness, energy resilience and employment, and reducing emissions from freight transport.
